scenes.tts: Two factors switch on the same receptor at the axon tip. Why does a neuron need both?
scenes.visual: Title card: Two Factors, One Receptor. Two coloured factors converge on one TrkA receptor.
scenes.narration: Two factors switch on the same receptor at the axon tip. Why does a neuron need both?

scenes.tts: In the mouse, sympathetic axons grow out along blood vessels before reaching the organs they innervate.
scenes.visual: A sympathetic axon grows along a blood vessel toward an organ.
scenes.narration: In the mouse, sympathetic axons grow out along blood vessels before reaching the organs they innervate.

scenes.tts: The vessels, an intermediate target, make N T 3. The final targets make N G F.
scenes.caption: The vessels, an intermediate target, make NT-3. The final targets make NGF.
scenes.visual: The vessel glows in one colour, labelled NT-3; the organ in another, labelled NGF.
scenes.narration: The vessels, an intermediate target, make NT-3. The final targets make NGF.

scenes.tts: Both factors can activate Track A.
scenes.caption: Both factors can activate TrkA.
scenes.visual: Both factors bind TrkA; the receptor lights up either way.

scenes.tts: Kuruvilla, Ginty and colleagues gave each factor only to the distal axons of sympathetic neurons in culture.
scenes.visual: Compartmented dish: factor in the side chamber only, none at the cell bodies. Credit: Kuruvilla and colleagues, 2004.
scenes.narration: Kuruvilla, Ginty and colleagues gave each factor only to the distal axons of sympathetic neurons in culture.

scenes.tts: With N T 3 on the axon tips, do the axons grow? Do the cell bodies survive?
scenes.caption: With NT-3 on the axon tips, do the axons grow? Do the cell bodies survive?
scenes.visual: A table with rows NGF and NT-3 and columns growth and survival, all question marks.
scenes.narration: With NT-3 on the axon tips, do the axons grow? Do the cell bodies survive?

scenes.tts: N T 3 supported local axon growth through Track A. But the cell bodies did not survive.
scenes.caption: NT-3 supported local axon growth through TrkA. But the cell bodies did not survive.
scenes.visual: NT-3 row fills in: growth yes, survival no.
scenes.narration: NT-3 supported local axon growth through TrkA. But the cell bodies did not survive.

scenes.tts: N G F supported both growth and survival.
scenes.caption: NGF supported both growth and survival.
scenes.visual: NGF row fills in: growth yes, survival yes.
scenes.narration: NGF supported both growth and survival.

scenes.visual: A new table column appears: carried back to the cell body.

scenes.tts: N G F and Track A complexes were taken into the cell and carried back to the cell body.
scenes.caption: NGF and TrkA complexes were taken into the cell and carried back to the cell body.
scenes.visual: An NGF-TrkA endosome rides dynein to the cell body. NGF row: carried back, yes.
scenes.narration: NGF and TrkA complexes were taken into the cell and carried back to the cell body.

scenes.tts: N T 3 and Track A complexes were not stably carried back.
scenes.caption: NT-3 and TrkA complexes were not stably carried back.
scenes.visual: NT-3 lights up TrkA at the tip; the complex is taken into local endosomes that do not make the long trip back toward the cell body. NT-3 row: carried back, no (not stably).
scenes.narration: NT-3 and TrkA complexes were not stably carried back.

scenes.tts: So N T 3 switches the receptor on at the tip. But that signal is not carried home.
scenes.caption: So NT-3 switches the receptor on at the tip. But that signal is not carried home.
scenes.visual: The lit receptor at the tip; the cell body stays dim.
scenes.narration: So NT-3 switches the receptor on at the tip. But that signal is not carried home.

scenes.tts: It is not useless. In mice lacking N T 3, sympathetic axon growth and target innervation were impaired.
scenes.caption: It is not useless. In mice lacking NT-3, sympathetic axon growth and target innervation were impaired.
scenes.visual: A knockout mouse panel: fewer and shorter sympathetic axons along the vessel, and less of the organ innervated than in a control. Label: NT-3 knockout: growth and innervation impaired.
scenes.narration: It is not useless. In mice lacking NT-3, sympathetic axon growth and target innervation were impaired.

scenes.tts: The paper also proposed a handoff.
scenes.visual: The axon reaches the organ; the vessel fades behind it.
scenes.narration: The paper also proposed a handoff.

scenes.tts: Retrograde N G F signaling raises a second neurotrophin receptor, p seventy five.
scenes.caption: Retrograde NGF signaling raises a second neurotrophin receptor, p75.
scenes.visual: p75 receptors appear on the neuron. Label: p75.
scenes.narration: Retrograde NGF signaling raises a second neurotrophin receptor, p75.

scenes.tts: As p seventy five rises, the neuron responds less to N T 3.
scenes.caption: As p75 rises, the neuron responds less to NT-3.
scenes.visual: The NT-3 response dims as p75 rises; the vessel's colour fades from the axon while the organ's stays. Label: less responsive to the intermediate target once at the final one.
scenes.narration: As p75 rises, the neuron responds less to NT-3.

scenes.tts: A factor that acts only locally can steer an axon. It cannot, by itself, keep the neuron alive.
scenes.visual: Two panels: NT-3 steering an axon along the vessel; NGF signal arriving at the cell body.
scenes.narration: A factor that acts only locally can steer an axon. It cannot, by itself, keep the neuron alive.

scenes.tts: So competition for the final target depends on the trafficking of the receptor, not only on binding.
scenes.visual: Several axons converge on one organ. Label: trafficking, not only binding.
scenes.narration: So competition for the final target depends on the trafficking of the receptor, not only on binding.

scenes.tts: Takeaway: binding at the tip is not enough. Survival needs a signal that makes it home able to signal.
scenes.visual: Closing card: binding at the tip is not enough. Survival needs a signal that makes it home able to signal.
scenes.narration: Takeaway: binding at the tip is not enough. Survival needs a signal that makes it home able to signal.
